# Strada.Brain — Copilot instructions

This file is a pointer, not a copy. The canonical instructions for every agent working in this repository are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read it first. It is a router: the rules themselves are contracts in [`docs/contracts/README.md`](../docs/contracts/README.md). Open an area's contract before you change code in it.

The earlier version of this file was a copy of the router, and it went stale: it listed three channel adapters that had been removed in August. One file, linked from everywhere, cannot drift.
